name: 66043 · Lansing, KS
findings: ZIP 66043 (Lansing) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66043 (Lansing) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66043 (Lansing) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
